subject: Information Technology
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for RDBMS in CBSE Class 11 Information Technology.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Information Technology (802), Unit-4: RDBMS covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
